'Whenever Dominia attacks a hero, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a red card, look at their hand and banish a card from it.' Draconic Illusionist - Dragon Ally.

TRIGGER: TRIGGERED + ON_ATTACK + ability-level conditions [ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO] (condition_types.py:1960-1977 - combat.attack_target is set only for permanent/ally targets, so a hero attack leaves it None and the condition passes). Ability-level conditions are checked at resolution; ON_ATTACK fires at attack declaration, which is when 'whenever Dominia attacks a hero' is true.

REVEAL: REVEAL_TOP_DECK amount 1 into 'revealed' (effect_types.py:2229-2256 reads amount/into; stores the revealed card(s) as a list plus '<into>_owner').

RED TEST: REF_PITCH_IS ref 'revealed' pitch 1 (condition_types.py:1979-2009 - red = pitch 1; REVEAL_TOP_DECK always stores a list, and this condition unwraps a one-element list, so 'reveal the top card, if it's red' works; empty deck stores [] which fails len==1 -> correctly False).

DEVIATION FROM THE TRIAGE LIST, deliberate: it named MAY, but the printed text has no 'may' - 'If it's a red card, look at their hand and banish a card from it' is mandatory once the reveal is red. So the whole consequence is one CONDITIONAL_EFFECT with when/then (effect_types.py:3697+; note 'conditions' on the effect would have been popped as an effect-level gate and skipped the branch), not MAY.

LOOK + BANISH: LOOK_AT zone HAND player OPPONENT amount ALL into 'their_hand' (effect_types.py:3356-3415 reads zone/player/amount/into; HAND is a supported zone; OPPONENT is correct because Dominia attacked the opposing hero). SELECT_FROM_REF mode ANY min 1 max 1 into 'chosen' (effect_types.py:3540-3591 reads ref/mode/min/max/into; pool is the raw ref contents, which is right here - any card may be banished, no filter needed; empty hand leaves chosen=[] harmlessly). BANISH_REF ref 'chosen' from_zone 'hand' (effect_types.py:3726-3752 reads ref/from_zone; from_zone MUST be named because LOOK_AT peeks without moving, and banish() only removes from the origin when told which zone - effect_keywords.py:173-176 resolves 'hand' via getattr(player, origin_zone)).

FIDELITY NOTE: 'their hand' means the attacked hero's hand; the DSL expresses zones relative to SELF/OPPONENT only, so in a multiplayer context this would look at the controller's opponent rather than the attack target. In this engine's 1v1 model those are the same player.
